description: Implementation of DispmanxResourcePool class managing DispmanxYUV420Resource objects for Raspberry Pi 4, including resource allocation, deallocation, and cleanup.

classes.name: DispmanxResourcePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of DispmanxYUV420Resource objects, handling resource allocation and freeing based on frame size changes.

methods.name: DispmanxResourcePool::DispmanxResourcePool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource pool with a maximum number of resources.

methods.name: DispmanxResourcePool::~DispmanxResourcePool
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up all resources in the pool.

methods.name: DispmanxResourcePool::Alloc
methods.description: Allocates a DispmanxYUV420Resource, reusing or creating new resources as needed.

methods.name: DispmanxResourcePool::Free
methods.description: Frees a resource, either recycling it or deleting if frame size has changed.

methods.name: DispmanxResourcePool::DisposeDispmanxYUV420Resource
methods.description: Static method to dispose of a DispmanxYUV420Resource, called with context and resource pointers.
